{{Top|leg}}
'''Bitter End''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the far side of the [[Bay of Tears]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. Bitter End had numbered some six hundred and sixty thousand citizens before plagues and madness had rendered it a shadow of its former glory a decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
